title: FTC along rays through the origin for Lipschitz functions, valid for a.e. point
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and u : ℝⁿ → ℝ L-Lipschitz (ℝⁿ = Euclid n). Then for Lebesgue-almost every x ∈ ℝⁿ and every t ∈ ℝ: u(x) − u(tx) = ∫_t^1 Du(σx)x dσ, where Du = fderiv ℝ u.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Euclid n → ℝ) (L : NNReal), LipschitzWith L u → ∀ᵐ x : Euclid n, ∀ t : ℝ, u x - u (t • x) = ∫ σ in t..1, fderiv ℝ u (σ • x) x
